en: Black‑and‑white winter scene of a snow-covered village surrounded by dense coniferous forest and hills. Several wooden houses stand among tall fir trees, and a road or path curves through the snow toward a small bridge in the middle distance. On a slope higher up stands a larger building, possibly a hotel or sanatorium, overlooking a cleared snowy field. The caption at the bottom left reads "Bärenfels im Winter."
